---
name: sdlc-prototype
description: Craft an HTML prototype as an artifact for discussion with the human.
---

Write all output, reports, questions and artifacts in English.

Return a complete standalone HTML document with inline CSS and fictional sample
data. Use the assigned brief and evidence. Explain intended behavior and assumptions
in HTML comments. Do not modify project implementation or Git. The coordinator
saves the returned HTML as a versioned artifact. A prototype is not accepted scope
or verified production implementation. The human and Copilot master refine it.
